annotations.text:
The card that renders under every property the agent mentions.

Two problems, and they have different fixes. The visual one: the card is the search-results list row, which is borderless by design because the list has dividers — dropped in a grey bubble it reads as another paragraph. The content one: the prompt tells the model to bold the address before emitting the token, so the address, the status and the proposal are all said twice.

Read left to right. Each option moves the same line — how much identity the card carries versus the prose.

Drawn at the 420px Ask drawer these actually ship in, not the width in your screenshot — worth checking where that wider view came from.

All three give the card a real surface: white fill on the grey bubble, a border, and in B a 1px shadow. Today it has none of those at rest — only a hover, which says nothing on touch.
